item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello! Lovely to see you. Here's your weather for Thursday, October 15. It's Thursday, almost the end of the week. In Shanghai today, expect it to be under a blanket of cloud. The warmest part of the day will be 25 degrees, and the coolest 17. A warm one, but nothing too fierce. Rain is very unlikely today. Here's something to notice: today is almost exactly as warm as yesterday. Two days the same in a row! Look up at the clouds today. Can you find one shaped like an animal? Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be sunny with a few showers, reaching 28 degrees. What would you tell a friend about jumpers and socks? That's all from the weather desk. Enjoy your day!
